```yaml
name: Replay Benchmark

on:
  schedule:
    # Run every Monday at 00:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force_run:
        description: 'Force run benchmark'
        required: false
        default: 'false'

permissions:
  contents: write
  pages: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .
          # Install specific benchmark dependencies if needed
          pip install pytest pytest-benchmark

      - name: Check Environment
        run: |
          python check_env.py --auto-install || true

      - name: Run Replay Benchmark
        run: |
          mkdir -p results
          python scripts/run_replay_bench.py --output results/benchmark.json
        env:
          PYTHONPATH: ${{ github.workspace }}

      - name: Post Pytest Results
        if: always()
        uses: pmeier/pytest-results-action@v0.7.2
        with:
          path: results/pytest-results.xml
          summary: true
          display-options: fEX
          title: "Pytest Results"
          fail-on-empty: false

      - name: Upload Benchmark Results
        uses: benchmark-action/github-action-benchmark@v1
        with:
          name: Alpha Agent Replay Benchmark
          tool: 'customSmallerIsBetter'
          output-file-path: results/benchmark.json
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          auto-push: true
          # Optional: Comment on PRs if benchmark changes significantly
          comment-on-alert: true
          alert-threshold: '115%'
          fail-on-alert: false

      - name: Update Benchmark History
        run: |
          # Append current run metrics to docs/bench_history.csv
          mkdir -p docs
          if [ ! -f docs/bench_history.csv ]; then
            echo "timestamp,commit_sha,metric_value,status" > docs/bench_history.csv
          fi
          
          # Extract metric from benchmark.json (assuming structure {"metric": value})
          METRIC=$(python -c "import json; data=json.load(open('results/benchmark.json')); print(data.get('metric', 0))")
          TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
          COMMIT_SHA=${{ github.sha }}
          STATUS="success"
          
          echo "${TIMESTAMP},${COMMIT_SHA},${METRIC},${STATUS}" >> docs/bench_history.csv

      - name: Commit and Push Changes
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v5
        with:
          commit_message: 'chore: update benchmark history [skip ci]'
          file_pattern: docs/bench_history.csv
          commit_user_name: github-actions[bot]
          commit_user_email: github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          skip_fetch: true
          skip_dirty_check: true
```
